en.title: Acne & Skin
en.who: Guests who mark breakouts, oily skin, breakouts before their period, marks left after pimples, or breakouts when stressed. Ask Irene for her skin guide sheet too.
studyWhy: all illness starts in the gut

say: I totally get it. You do everything right on the outside, and it still keeps coming back. And it always shows up at the worst time.
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "When do you break out most, and where?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my sister", "a friend from school"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that a pimple needs four things: too much oil, a blocked pore, bacteria, and inflammation. Skincare only handles the last two. The oil and the inflammation are set from the inside, by sugar spikes, the gut, stress and sleep.
That's why washing harder doesn't work: stripped skin just makes more oil. And the marks are mostly pigment, not scars, so not picking and wearing sunscreen matter more than anything.
So I'd work on it from the inside and the outside together.
found.tip: Two or three sentences, then go to the map. Pick the row that matches what they marked.

map: Calms the inflammation from the inside, through the liver and the gut
Artistry anti-acne toner and Spot On Dots
The toner clears the pore; patch it instead of picking
Stops the sugar spike that turns the oil up
Before the period, on the jaw
Gets ahead of the monthly shift. Ask first if pregnant, trying, or on hormonal birth control
Vitamin C, Artistry Vitamin C serum, SPF 50
Keeps the marks from getting darker
Washes gentler, so the skin stops overcompensating
en.ask: From what you told me, I'd start with these, inside and outside together. Want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Deep painful lumps, scarring, acne with irregular periods or extra hair growth, or breakouts affecting their mood? See a doctor or dermatologist first.

zh.title: 皮肤与痘痘
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了爆痘、出油、经期前冒痘、痘印、压力一大就冒痘的客人。也可以找Irene要她的皮肤指南。

say: 我特别懂。外面该用的都用了，还是反反复复。而且总在最不想冒的时候冒出来。
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“一般什么时候最容易冒？长在哪里？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我姐姐”“我一个同学”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来学到，长一颗痘要四件事凑齐：油太多、毛孔堵住、细菌、发炎。护肤品只管得了后两件。出油和发炎是身体里面决定的：血糖冲高、肠道、压力、睡眠。
所以越洗越油，洗得太干净，皮肤反而出更多油。痘印大多是色素不是疤，不挤、做好防晒，比什么都重要。
所以我会建议里外一起调。
found.tip: 两三句就够，然后看下面的对照表，挑跟对方勾的那一项对得上的。

map: 从肝和肠道入手，把身体里面的炎症降下来
雅姿玫瑰控痘爽肤水、雅姿痘痘贴
爽肤水疏通毛孔；冒出来就贴，不挤
挡住把出油推高的血糖冲高
女性周期支持，整个月都吃
提前应对每个月的变化。怀孕、备孕或服用激素避孕药的先问医生
维生素C缓释片、雅姿维C精华、雅姿SPF50防晒
洗得温和，皮肤就不用拼命补油
zh.ask: 按你说的情况，我建议里外一起，先从这几样开始。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 如果是又深又痛的硬包、已经留疤、痘痘同时伴随月经不规律或毛发变多，或者痘痘让你情绪很低落，请先去看医生或皮肤科。
